_note: MOCK registry. Priors and costs are placeholders, not measurements. Replace with the Repair team's registry.

strategies.name: Re-ground on tool output
strategies.description: Before continuing, re-read the latest tool outputs and state only facts they support.
strategies.template: Before you respond, re-read every tool output so far. A previous attempt at this point made a mistake: {rationale} Base your next action strictly on the tool outputs.

strategies.name: Policy / plan reminder
strategies.description: Restate the relevant policy rules and the user's goal before the next action.
strategies.template: Before your next action, restate the user's request and the policy rules that apply. A previous attempt at this point went wrong: {rationale}

strategies.name: Fix tool invocation
strategies.description: Check tool name and argument values against the tool schema and earlier outputs.
strategies.template: Your next tool call must match the tool schema exactly and use argument values taken from earlier tool outputs. A previous attempt made an invalid call: {rationale}

strategies.name: Ask the user to clarify
strategies.description: Ask a targeted clarification question instead of assuming.
strategies.template: The user's request is ambiguous at this point ({rationale}). Ask one specific clarification question before acting.

strategies.name: Retry after transient failure
strategies.description: Re-issue the failed call after a short wait; no reasoning change.

strategies.name: Break repetition loop
strategies.description: Point out the repeated calls and require a different next action.
strategies.template: You have repeated the same action several times without progress ({rationale}). Choose a different next action.

strategies.name: Generic reflection
strategies.description: Untargeted fallback: think again carefully before the next action.
strategies.template: A previous attempt went wrong at this point. Think carefully about the user's goal and the tool outputs before acting.
